find context stratigraphy

  • CURIE: gmeow:findContextStratigraphy
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/findContextStratigraphy
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence
  • Box roles: CBox role, RBox role (What is this?)

The stratigraphic unit or layer associated with a carrier's find context. Range is gmeow:Entity (opaque reference) because general stratigraphic domain modeling is deferred to archaeological-domain model; this property provides the language-facing hook. Non-functional: competing stratigraphic interpretations coexist.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:ArchaeologicalFindContext -> gmeow:Entity Sub-property of: gmeow:observationResult

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:findContextStratigraphy from gmeow:ArchaeologicalFindContext to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:observationResult, gmeow:ArchaeologicalFindContext, gmeow:Entity
